description: mxl-st2110-gateway: PTP, NIC, ST 2110 ingest/egress, MXL readers and domains, NMOS (generated by monitoring/tools/gen_dashboard.py)

panels.description: /readyz: config valid, MTL up, PTP locked, clock offset in range, configured domains ok, NMOS registered (§10).
panels.title: Ready

panels.description: Per port; absent when ptp.mode = external or on the kernel backend (§5.2).
panels.title: PTP locked

panels.description: §5.3: MTL PTP time minus the host CLOCK_TAI. Beyond ptp.max_offset_ns the gateway is not ready.
panels.title: MTL − host TAI

panels.description: §5.5 dual-port BMCA: the port whose PTP instance steers the PHC.
panels.title: BMCA selection per port

panels.description: Packets lost on leg P vs R before the 2022-7 merge. Loss on one leg is harmless while the other is clean.
panels.title: ST 2022-7 sequence loss per leg

panels.description: TAI now minus the origin time of the last frame written (§3.7).
panels.title: Origin age

panels.description: Time from grain available to its TX deadline; negative = late.
panels.title: TX lead time

panels.description: Writer head index minus read index, in grains (§5.7). Mirror flows on another host show the replication delay here.
panels.title: MXL read lag

panels.description: §5.8: receivers wait with backoff (500 ms → 5 s) until the flow or domain appears.
panels.title: Flow-not-found retries

panels.description: waiting_for_flow and no_signal are expected while a flow is absent (§5.8); they do not affect readiness.
panels.title: Essence state

panels.description: Domain each enabled MXL Receiver reads from; mirror = replicated by mxl-fabrics-agent (§8.6).
panels.title: Resolved MXL domains

panels.description: Domains found under mxl.scan_path (§8.5); conflict = duplicate domain ids.
panels.title: Discovered domains
